edges.reason: msg.sender is the mint recipient and receives any excess ETH refund inside mint.
msg.sender is mixed into the keccak256 pseudo-random token selection seed.
msg.sender acts as the buyer in buyPunk and receives the NFT via _safeTransfer.
withdraw reads pendingWithdrawals[msg.sender] and sends ETH back to msg.sender.
msg.sender is recorded as the new bidder in enterBidForPunk.
msg.sender is treated as the seller accepting the bid and is credited.
msg.sender must match the stored bidder and receives the refund.
The hook uses _msgSender (msg.sender) indirectly through internal transfer flows.
onlyPunkOwner compares msg.sender against ownerOf(tokenId) to gate privileged market actions.
msg.sender is stored as the seller when a listing is removed.
msg.sender is stored as the seller in the Offer created by offerPunkForSale.
msg.sender is stored as the seller in the private listing.
seedInitialContractState is guarded by onlyOwner, which compares msg.sender with owner().
Token index randomness consumes block.timestamp, making the outcome miner-influenceable (timestamp dependency).
mint delegates the actual token creation loop to _mint.
mint calls getCostForMintingPhunks to compute the required payment.
The computed cost is returned into mint's costForMintingPhunks variable.
mint forwards ETH to the buyer (refund) and to the owner through _safeTransferETH.
mint requires isMintOn to be true before proceeding.
mint checks remaining supply against numTotalPhunks().
The mint loop obtains each token id via useRandomAvailableToken.
_mint decrements _numAvailableTokens for every token minted.
_mint enforces the MAX_MINTABLE_AT_ONCE cap.
_safeMint performs an external onERC721Received call to the receiving contract before returning.
The derived random index is passed to useAvailableTokenAtIndex.
The random index is reduced modulo _numAvailableTokens.
useAvailableTokenAtIndex reads and rewrites the _availableTokens pool.
useAvailableTokenAtIndex decrements _numAvailableTokens after selection.
Seeding calls useAvailableTokenAtIndex to consume pool slots in decreasing order.
Seeding requires that saleHasBeenStarted is still false.
Seeding reads and updates _lastTokenIdMintedInInitialSet.
startMinting sets isMintOn to true.
startMinting sets saleHasBeenStarted to true.
endMinting sets isMintOn back to false.
setBaseURI writes the _baseTokenURI state variable.
setContractURI writes the contractURI state variable.
punkNoLongerForSale overwrites the Offer entry in punksOfferedForSale.
offerPunkForSale writes a new Offer into punksOfferedForSale.
offerPunkForSaleToAddress writes a restricted Offer into punksOfferedForSale.
buyPunk reads the listing from punksOfferedForSale.
buyPunk cancels the listing by calling punkNoLongerForSale.
buyPunk credits pendingWithdrawals for the seller and for a refunded buyer bid.
buyPunk reads and clears the buyer's own bid in punkBids.
buyPunk calls _safeTransfer, invoking onERC721Received on the buyer before pendingWithdrawals is credited.
withdraw reads and zeroes pendingWithdrawals[msg.sender].
withdraw sends the balance through the raw _safeTransferETH helper.
enterBidForPunk reads and overwrites the Bid struct in punkBids.
enterBidForPunk credits the outbid bidder's pendingWithdrawals.
acceptBidForPunk reads and clears the bid in punkBids.
acceptBidForPunk credits the seller's pendingWithdrawals with the bid value.
acceptBidForPunk resets the Offer entry for the token.
acceptBidForPunk performs a safe transfer to the bidder, triggering the receiver hook.
withdrawBidForPunk reads and clears the bid in punkBids.
withdrawBidForPunk refunds the bidder through _safeTransferETH.
The transfer hook cancels any active listing by calling punkNoLongerForSale.
The hook inspects punksOfferedForSale to decide whether to delist.
The hook inspects and clears punkBids when the new owner has a bid.
The hook credits pendingWithdrawals for refunded bids.
punkNoLongerForSale is gated by the onlyPunkOwner modifier.
offerPunkForSale is gated by the onlyPunkOwner modifier.
offerPunkForSaleToAddress is gated by the onlyPunkOwner modifier.
acceptBidForPunk is gated by the onlyPunkOwner modifier.
_safeTransferETH performs a raw call{value:} to an arbitrary address forwarding all gas, ignoring failure.
getCostForMintingPhunks validates supply using numTotalPhunks().
tokenURI obtains the base prefix from the _baseURI override.
tokenURI indirectly reads the _baseTokenURI state variable through _baseURI.

normalization_plan.reason: The _numToMint parameter is only meaningful within mint's supply and cost checks.
totalSupply is a transient cache local to mint's supply-bound check.
costForMintingPhunks holds the value returned to mint for its payment checks.
_numToMint is the loop bound parameter of the internal _mint function.
updatedNumAvailableTokens is written back into _numAvailableTokens at the end of _mint.
newTokenId is the per-iteration id passed to _safeMint inside _mint.
_numToFetch is only used as entropy input for the random seed.
_i is only used as entropy input for the random seed.
randomNum is the intermediate hash produced inside useRandomAvailableToken.
randomIndex is the modulo-reduced pool index computed in the same function.
indexToUse is the parameter consumed by useAvailableTokenAtIndex.
valAtIndex is a transient read from _availableTokens inside the selection logic.
result is the function's returned token index derived from the pool.
lastIndex is a transient computation over _numAvailableTokens for the swap-and-pop.
_numToMint is the pricing input parameter of getCostForMintingPhunks.
_owner is the query parameter of getPhunksBelongingToOwner.
numPhunks caches balanceOf(_owner) to size the enumeration array.
result is the enumeration array assembled and returned by the view function.
tokenOwners is the array parameter driving the seeding loop.
tokens is the parallel array parameter of the seeding function.
lastTokenIdMintedInInitialSetCopy is a working copy written back to state at the end of seeding.
token is the per-iteration id validated and minted during seeding.
baseURI is the setter parameter stored into _baseTokenURI.
_contractURI is the setter parameter stored into contractURI.
tokenId identifies the listing removed by punkNoLongerForSale.
tokenId identifies the listed token in offerPunkForSale.
minSalePriceInWei is stored into the Offer created by offerPunkForSale.
tokenId identifies the listed token in offerPunkForSaleToAddress.
minSalePriceInWei is stored into the restricted Offer.
toAddress becomes the onlySellTo restriction of the private listing.
tokenId is the purchase target parameter of buyPunk.
offer is the memory copy of the listing validated inside buyPunk.
seller is the cached offer seller credited in buyPunk.
bid is the buyer's own bid refunded during buyPunk.
amount is the pending balance read and sent in withdraw.
tokenId is the bid target parameter of enterBidForPunk.
existing is the current highest bid refunded when outbid.
tokenId is the token whose bid is accepted.
minPrice is the seller's price floor checked against the bid.
seller caches msg.sender as the credited party in acceptBidForPunk.
bid is the memory copy of the accepted bid.
amount is the bid value credited to pendingWithdrawals.
tokenId is the token whose bid is being withdrawn.
bid is the memory copy refunded by withdrawBidForPunk.
amount is the bid value sent back to the bidder.
_tokenId is the metadata query parameter of tokenURI.
from is the transfer source parameter of the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
to is the transfer destination used to refund matching bids in the hook.
tokenId identifies the transfer to delist/refund in the hook.
to is the raw call recipient inside _safeTransferETH.
value is the wei amount forwarded by the raw call.
tokenId is the parameter checked by the onlyPunkOwner modifier.
interfaceId is the ERC165 identifier forwarded to super.supportsInterface.
